variants.headline: Still in view: business plan abandoned before opening
variants.sub: The planned {business} will not open: {founder} has given up the plan.
variants.body:
The founder {founder} has abandoned the plan for {business} before opening. Coverage of this story continues; the original event remains the starting point for the questions examined here.

A terminated plan can retain financial consequences. Our assessment favours {target} over a verdict that confuses an adverse interpretation with an established fact.
